_about: Variant 2 enemy roster: shared with variant 1, plus the Echo. Three threat families, three answers: magic is absorbed (if you face it), steel is rolled, unblockable is left or broken. Seconds, metres, HP. Authored.

soldiers.name: Hastatus conscript
soldiers.behaviour: approach with stamina-costed sprint, lunge, back off 1 s

soldiers.name: Scutum bearer
soldiers.behaviour: advance in pairs, shields facing the player
soldiers.teaches: flank, pierce (Brand Lance), or area damage

creatures.name: Cinder hound
creatures.behaviour: pack uses 2 engagement slots around the player; the third circles

creatures.name: Mire maw
creatures.behaviour: stationary artillery; pulls players who stand in line
creatures.teaches: absorb a slow projectile; leave a line telegraph

creatures.name: Thornback
creatures.behaviour: charges along a lane; stunned if it hits a wall
creatures.teaches: unblockable: leave the lane, punish the stun

creatures.name: Hush moth

attacks.effect: drain 6 mana per second on contact

creatures.teaches: absorb is not always the answer; area spells

mages._about: AI mages use the player's own kernel: same spells, same absorb, same tier clock. Competence is a dial with human-plausible caps, never extra stats.

competence.usesTierCurve: holds the best spell for its tier

plans._about: Rival plans keyed by Water preset name; opt-in only (Lab setup toggle, runtime games.rivalPlans for Tiro, default off). A plan steers spacing, ward budget and spell timing; competence still owns reactions, aim and perfect odds, and every opening it reads is at least the competence reaction delay old. Distances are fractions of the composition's own spell rangeM. Under a plan a curve row's denied-perfect raise also keeps deniedPerfectMarginS over the live impact, since plan movement makes impact estimates drift. close: when an opening is seen (target release, target roll, target ward down) a seeded draw against the summed weights starts a sprint toward the target (still casting on the way, pausing while its ward is planned), arms commitLine inside armFractionOfRange of its range and presses it inside engageFractionOfRange, then backs off for withdrawS and re-arms after rearmS; an approach gives up after approachMaxS. ranged: holds a band of its longest damaging composition range; when two enemy releases are seen within streamWindowS and their shots land faster than it can react, it raises its ward ahead of the next expected shot on that seen rhythm and flight, old enough to miss the perfect window, and drops it after the first guarded hit; with mana under wardReserveFraction it raises no ward (stream or reactive) for threats below lowValueDamage and takes them; once its ward is down it decides a damaging counter-cast within counterWindowS of each seen enemy release.

echo.name: your Echo
echo.from: Loop 2 onward, a semifinal may be replaced by the Echo
echo.loadout: the player's loadout from the previous loop's Games (lines and branches)
echo.perfectAbsorbChance: the player's measured perfect-absorb rate over the previous loop's Games, capped at 0.45
echo.art: the player's figure with a shadow tint; no new images
